## 同尺度母图

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a SIX-TIER GAME WORKSTATION SCALE MASTER image, 3 columns by 2 rows, six DIFFERENT compact crafting stations, one per cell. All stations EXACT SAME physical bounding envelope and SAME camera zoom: base 1.6m wide x 0.9m deep (16:9 plan), total machine height 1.3m, identical low rectangular bevelled plinth with four corner bolts, identical work surface height 0.75m. Entire machine including tools contained within that envelope, NO gigantic factories, no miniature factory with tiny toy robots. All have same comfortably hand-sized tools and controls, same chunky material scale and panel thickness. Advanced stations are sophisticated single compact workstations, not longer production lines. Same elevated front-right camera in each cell, same pixel base width 420px, comparable height, ample margins, neutral beige background, low-poly chunky faceted 3D game style, soft light, minimal textures, 5-8 readable major shapes per machine, do not cover surfaces with tiny details. No people, text, labels or watermark. Top left T1 manual bench: rusty steel table, one chunky manual lever press, small vise, few hanging tools, open underframe, no electronics. Top middle T2 motor-driven lathe: same-sized solid cast-iron table cabinet with ONE large chuck, short bar and simple sliding cutter, two handwheels, yellow motor cap, no screen. Top right T3 single-head plasma CNC: same-sized graphite enclosed workbench, ONE window revealing single gantry cutter and purple-white fine beam onto small jig, small control panel. Bottom left T4 multi-axis plasma: same-sized grey/cobalt semi-enclosed workbench with EXACTLY TWO compact articulated robot arms (symbolic simplification of multi-axis), tilt-turntable, small blue fine beams, integrated rear frame, no eight-arm octopus. Bottom middle T5 cold-atom batch station: same-sized white/black compact clean enclosed workbench, TWO parallel nozzle heads over one SHORT indexed 3-position work tray holding 3 identical parts, icy-white highlights, no long conveyor, no large roof units, no multi-room production line. Bottom right T6 intelligent combined machining workstation: same-sized dark graphite/gold compact seamless workbench shell, single protected panoramic front window with one suspended integrated MULTITOOL head and one robotic micro-gripper above a levitating geometric finished-part jig, small cyan blueprint display, subtle gold/cyan core, dense technology represented by elegant precision and integrated surfaces, no towers, server rooms, factory zones, large assembly lines. Clearly distinct silhouettes and interfaces but identical scale and ground footprint across all six, tier advancement conveyed by control/automation/integration, NOT by size or more tiny parts.
